title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 8 April 1989 #121 - ISSN 0712-7774 Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 8, dated April 1989, is a collectible comic book published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. The comic book is a single issue featuring the character Cerebus and is written by Dave Sim and Gerhard. The intended audience is general and it is suitable for all ages. The comic book is in English language and has a vintage value.
